newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET - NORTHERN TRANSVAAL 129-3 AGAINST NATAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET - NORTHERN TRANSVAAL 129-3 AGAINST NATAL.

text.p: Natal were in a strong position at the close of the third day's play in the Supersport Series match against Northern Transvaal at Centurion Park.
Set the unlikely task of scoring 501 to win Northerns were 129 for three at the close, still 372 runs short. The home side will have to bat throughout the final day to save the match.
Natal batted circumspectly before lunch as they sought to play Northerns out of the game. But in the afternoon session newly appointed captain Dale Benkenstein took the attack to the bowlers.

Benkenstein made 87 from 139 balls with 12 fours and a six. He got good support from recovering national all rounder Shaun Pollock who made 33. Benkenstein declared at the fall of the ninth wicket with Natal's total on 261.
Pollock also starred with the ball when Northerns batted again, taking two for 30 from 11 hostile overs. Northerns were reduced to 38 for three before a fine fourth wicket stand saved their blushes.

Former West Indies captain Richie Richardson emerged from a form slump to score 48 not out from 87 balls with nine boundaries. Richardson has so far added 91 with Mike Rindel (34), but the pair will need to bat a lot longer to give their side hope on he final day.
